label: GDPR Art. 46 — Transfers subject to appropriate safeguards
body: 1. In the absence of a decision pursuant to Article 45, a controller or processor may transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation only if the controller or processor has provided appropriate safeguards, and on condition that enforceable data subject rights and effective legal remedies for data subjects are available.
2. The appropriate safeguards … may be provided for, without requiring any specific authorisation from a supervisory authority, by:
(a) a legally binding and enforceable instrument between public authorities or bodies;
(b) binding corporate rules in accordance with Article 47;
(c) standard data protection clauses adopted by the Commission …;
(d) standard data protection clauses adopted by a supervisory authority and approved by the Commission …;
(e) an approved code of conduct pursuant to Article 40 together with binding and enforceable commitments …;
(f) an approved certification mechanism pursuant to Article 42 …
